report.summary: SubprocessAdapter chunk 2: session streaming, event parsing, approve/reject/interrupt/terminate, and process stop.

handoff.purpose: Implement session event streaming, event parsing, and lifecycle methods (approve/reject/interrupt/terminate/stop_process).

symbols.name: events
symbols.note: Async generator yielding SessionStarted, AgentEvent, SessionEnded; reads process stdout; enforces timeout; publishes events.

symbols.name: _parse_line
symbols.note: Parses a line of output; returns TextDelta, AgentMessage, or None; handles JSON and text formats.

symbols.name: _parse_typed_event
symbols.note: Dispatches typed events from parsed JSON; returns TextDelta, AgentMessage, ToolRequested, ToolCompleted, CommandOutput, or system message.

symbols.name: approve
symbols.note: Raises NotImplementedError; one-shot CLI profiles do not support approval.

symbols.name: reject
symbols.note: Raises NotImplementedError; one-shot CLI profiles do not support rejection.

symbols.name: interrupt
symbols.note: Sends SIGINT to the session process if running.

symbols.name: _stop_process
symbols.note: Static method; terminates process with timeout, kills if needed.

symbols.name: terminate
symbols.note: Pops session, stops process, waits for stderr task with timeout.

claims.text: Lifecycle events are still observable, but aren't misrepresented as text generated by the model.
claims.why: The fallback returns AgentMessage with role='system' for unknown event types, so lifecycle events are marked as system messages.

claims.text: one-shot CLI profiles do not expose a portable approval protocol
claims.why: approve() raises NotImplementedError with exactly that message.

claims.text: one-shot CLI profiles do not expose a portable approval protocol
claims.why: reject() raises NotImplementedError with exactly that message.

observations.what: events yields SessionStarted and SessionEnded with direction 'system', and AgentEvents with direction 'output'.
_parse_typed_event handles many event types but returns None for empty text in 'text' events, which may cause the caller to skip the event.
stderr_task cancellation in terminate() may raise asyncio.CancelledError if not shielded, but the method does not catch it.
